reunionism.m: A policy in favour of reunion.

reunionists.m: More than one reunionist. reunionist: one who supports reunion.

reuniters.m: More than one reuniter. reuniter: one who reunites.

reupholstered.m: Past tense of reupholster. reupholster: to upholster again.

reupholstering.m: The act or process, or an instance, of upholstering again (that is, redoing some upholstery), usually to restore a chair or automotive…

reupholsters.m: A form of reupholster, as in “she reupholsters”. reupholster: to upholster again.

reusabilities.m: More than one reusability. reusability: the property or degree of being reusable.

reusability.m: The property or degree of being reusable.
